mapper.sql: c.comment_id, c.article_id, c.user_id, c.c_msg, c.c_star, c.c_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.nickname as user_nick, u.portrait as user_portrait FROM a_comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId} LIMIT 1
SELECT , u.nickname as user_nick, u.portrait as user_portrait FROM a_comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY c.c_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO a_comment (article_id, user_id, c_msg, c_star) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{userId}, #{commentMsg}, #{commentStar})
mapper.update: UPDATE a_comment SET c_star = c_star + 1 WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
UPDATE a_comment SET c_star = GREATEST(c_star - 1, 0) WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM a_comment WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
